name: DEPwD Free Coaching Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
provider: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
unchecked_criteria: Must have a benchmark disability of at least 40% under the RPwD Act 2016, with a valid disability certificate and UDID card or enrolment number
Indian nationals only; Aadhaar-based authentication is required
Not more than two children with disabilities of the same parents may receive benefits
Cannot receive another scholarship or stipend at the same time
Must meet the educational requirement of the exam (passed or studying in Class XII, or Bachelor's degree completed or in final year)
Coaching must be for a covered exam, e.g. UPSC, State PSC, SSC, RRB, banking, insurance, PSU, JEE, NEET, CAT, CLAT, CUET, CMAT, CA-CPT, GATE, TET, UGC-NET, CSIR-UGC NET
Physical coaching only (minimum 16 hours a week); at least 70% monthly Aadhaar-based attendance is needed to receive the allowances
Available only once, and not together with another Central or State Government coaching scheme
benefit: Coaching fee paid to the institute (up to Rs 75,000 for UPSC/State PSC, JEE/NEET and GATE; up to Rs 40,000 for other covered exams), maintenance allowance Rs 4,000/month, disability allowance Rs 2,000/month, book allowance Rs 5,000 per course. About 1,000 slots a year, 30% reserved for girls.
documents: Valid disability certificate issued by the competent authority
UDID card or UDID enrolment number
